Constraints  All characters are lowercase English letters. Output Format  Print an integer denoting the zero-indexed position of the character that makes  not a palindrome; if  is already a palindrome or no such character exists, print .  Sample Input  3 aaab baa aaa Sample Output  3 0 -1 Explanation  Test Case 1: "aaab"  Removing 'b' at index  results in a palindrome, so we print  on a new line.  Test Case 2: "baa"  Removing 'b' at index  results in a palindrome, so we print  on a new line.  Test Case 3: "aaa"  This string is already a palindrome, so we print ; however, , , and  are also all acceptable answers, as the string will still be a palindrome if any one of the characters at those indices are removed.
